name: Searxng

test_list.description: Map result URLs, titles, snippets, and provider identity to the SDK contract.
A non-JSON or invalid JSON response is reported without exposing response bodies.
Map connection failures, 5xx, 401, and 429 to the SDK error taxonomy.
Only the redactor output is included in the outgoing request.
Private and loopback endpoints are accepted only for an explicitly configured local SearXNG origin.
Do not return more than requested and allow cancellation to stop transport work.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configured base URL, engine allow-list, timeout, local-origin exception, and limiter.

inputs.name: redactor
inputs.description: SDK redactor applied before query data leaves the process.

output_description: A production SearXNG adapter using its JSON search API and returning SDK SearchHit values.
